observations.claim: August production deployments and rollbacks are recorded against deployment identifiers in a single log, giving a usable deployment history.
observations.follow_up: Confirm whether the log is the authoritative record or a secondary copy.

observations.claim: Six of fourteen August deployments landed outside the Tuesday/Thursday window defined by the release standard, and three of those six carry no documented exception.

count_assertion.unit: out-of-window deployments without a documented exception

observations.follow_up: Ask whether exceptions are recorded in a separate system, or whether these were unexcepted.
observations.scope_limit: August only; the standard's exception process may be recorded elsewhere.

observations.claim: All three repositories in the ESS export require a pull request with at least one approving review and a passing build-and-test status check before merge to the default branch.

count_assertion.unit: repositories with required review and status check

observations.follow_up: Confirm the repository inventory is complete before any group-wide statement.
observations.scope_limit: Three fictional repositories; export reflects configuration on 2026-09-18 only.

observations.claim: Every sampled merged pull request recorded at least one approving review and a passing status check; none was merged without review.

observations.follow_up: Widen the sample or request the full merge history for the period.
observations.scope_limit: Eight sampled pull requests from 2026Q3; not a census.
